title: The Wounded Quarry
text: The quarry lies on its side in the bracken, breathing hard, an arrow that is not yours buried in its flank. Its eye rolls toward you as it gathers its legs beneath it. It can still fight.

options.label: Finish it while it is down; it will not be this weak again.

outcomes.text: It fights to the last, and the last is a long time coming.

options.label: The healer tends its wound instead, and ends the hunt with mercy.

outcomes.text: Trembling, it lets them work, then limps away. The hunt ends another way.

options.label: The sharpest finds who wounded it, and why they did not finish the job.

outcomes.text: The arrow belongs to a rival House, fletched in their colours.
